blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Pia Cayetano on Thursday said she feels bad for athletes who experience online bashing, even floating the idea of jailing bashers. During a hearing of the Senate Committee on Sports evaluating the Philippine delegation’s participation in the 20th Asian Games, Cayetano proposed giving athletes additional funding to sustain them during training. “Can we make it happen, Chairman? Because it’s really lacking. And then the whole country rejoices when you win, and then there are people who bash you when you lose. My God!” she said. “Like, can we have those people jailed?
